name: ZPM_PARTNER_DIM_MEMBERS_
description: A generic intersection table that defines values selected for an owner such as a partner profile or program that allow multiple values to be selected from multi-choice dropdowns or shuttle pickers.

columns.name: PARTNER_DIM_MEMBERS_ID
columns.description: This column is the private key of this table.

columns.name: OWNER_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the entity that owns the relationship with the dimension data.  For example, partner profile, partner program, or enrollment.

columns.name: OWNER_TYPE
columns.description: The type of entity that owns the relationship with the dimension data.  For example, partner profile, partner program, or enrollment.

columns.name: PARTITION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The type of partition in which the data is stored.

columns.name: DIMENSION_CODE
columns.description: The dimension of the item being stored.  For example, geography.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_ID
columns.description: The reference to the actual dimension member item.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_PK1
columns.description: This is the ATTRIBUTE PK1 column.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_PK2
columns.description: This is the ATTRIBUTE PK1 column.

columns.name: DIM_SUBTYPE_CODE
columns.description: A specific type of item within the dimension code.  For example, for the products dimension there could be product items and product categories.

columns.name: DIMENSION_MEMBER_NAME
columns.description: The name of the dimension remember this record refers to.  This is stored in case the dimension member was removed and the user still needs to know the name of the item that was removed.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.
